rules.trigger_condition: Crane lift plan deviation count exceeds threshold in any rolling week
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies HSE Manager and Construction Manager immediately; Monitor Agent suspends confidence scoring for lifting tasks and flags all crane-dependent tasks as at-risk in the plan.

rules.trigger_condition: Tower crane inspection overdue or thorough examination certificate expiring within 7 days
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent flags crane-dependent tasks; Alert Agent sends warning to Construction Manager to book examination before certificate lapse and halt affected lifts if lapsed.

rules.trigger_condition: Wind speed stoppages of crane lifting operations occurring more than planned frequency
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent correlates stoppages with floor cycle slippage; Alert Agent warns Project Controls to re-forecast slab cycle and consider night-shift lifting windows.

rules.trigger_condition: Working at height near-miss reports spike above baseline in any week
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies HSE Manager for targeted intervention on affected floors; Monitor Agent increases scrutiny of edge protection and harness compliance records.

rules.trigger_condition: Lost time injury recorded on site
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent immediately notifies HSE Manager and Project Manager with incident context; Monitor Agent freezes productivity expectations for affected zone pending investigation.

rules.trigger_condition: Piling refusal or unexpected obstruction logged during boring operations
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent links event to geotechnical baseline; Alert Agent notifies Foundation/Geotech Engineer and Commercial Manager to assess variation exposure and programme impact.

rules.trigger_condition: Groundwater inflow or piezometer levels exceed dewatering design triggers
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent escalates to Foundation/Geotech Engineer and Construction Manager; Monitor Agent checks neighbouring settlement monitoring for correlated movement.

rules.trigger_condition: Concrete cube or cylinder test failure reported on structural pour
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent holds dependent striking/stressing tasks pending disposition; Alert Agent notifies Quality Manager and Structural Engineer for investigation workflow.

rules.trigger_condition: Ready-mix concrete delivery missed for two or more consecutive scheduled pours
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies Procurement Lead to activate secondary plant; Monitor Agent recalculates floor cycle forecast and flags downstream facade and MEP sequencing.

rules.trigger_condition: Slab cycle time exceeds baseline by more than 15 percent over rolling three floors
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent produces cycle-time variance analysis by activity; Alert Agent warns Construction Manager to deploy recovery actions before buffer erosion becomes critical-path impact.

rules.trigger_condition: Subcontractor insolvency warning signs detected such as late supplier payments or key staff departures
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies Commercial Manager for immediate financial health review; Monitor Agent flags all tasks of that subcontractor and identifies backup contractor options.

rules.trigger_condition: Skilled labour absenteeism or vacancy rate rising on facade or post-tensioning crews
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent adjusts productivity factors for affected trades; Alert Agent warns Construction Manager to trigger labour supply contingency and retention incentives.

rules.trigger_condition: Change order backlog value or count exceeds agreed threshold
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies Commercial Manager and Project Manager; Monitor Agent quantifies unassessed time impact on critical path and reports contingency drawdown correlation.

rules.trigger_condition: Subcontractor claims submissions trending upward week over week
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent compiles contemporaneous records coverage report; Alert Agent notifies Commercial Manager to convene claims review and settlement strategy session.

rules.trigger_condition: Planning permission or building control approval milestone forecast slipping beyond float
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies Permitting Lead and Project Manager; Monitor Agent re-baselines dependent procurement and mobilisation dates and quantifies knock-on long-lead exposure.

rules.trigger_condition: Facade air or water infiltration test failure recorded on installed zone
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent blocks zone sign-off and dependent internal fit-out tasks; Alert Agent notifies Facade Manager and Quality Manager with diagnostic and retest workflow.

rules.trigger_condition: Cladding fire performance evidence missing or non-conforming in submitted documentation
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent immediately escalates to Facade Manager, Quality Manager, and Project Manager; Monitor Agent suspends acceptance of affected cladding tasks pending certified evidence.

rules.trigger_condition: Curtain wall or cladding delivery schedule slip reported by supplier
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent re-sequences facade installation zones against available stock; Alert Agent notifies Procurement Lead to expedite shipments and assess closing-in sequence impact.

rules.trigger_condition: MEP riser clash count rising in federated model week over week
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies MEP Coordinator and Design Manager; Monitor Agent tracks clash burn-down and flags riser installation tasks within two weeks of unresolved critical clashes.

rules.trigger_condition: Elevator or escalator delivery milestone at risk per supplier forecast
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies Lift/Elevator Specialist and Procurement Lead; Monitor Agent models impact on shaft handover, commissioning, and overall completion critical path.

rules.trigger_condition: Waterproofing leak or basement water ingress reported post tanking installation
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent escalates to Quality Manager and Foundation/Geotech Engineer; Monitor Agent links to monitoring data, blocks dependent finishing tasks, and initiates diagnostic workflow.

rules.trigger_condition: Steel or rebar price index movement beyond escalation band in cost plan
rules.recommended_action: Monitor Agent re-prices remaining steel tonnage and updates forecast; Alert Agent notifies Commercial Manager to consider early bulk ordering or hedging decisions.

rules.trigger_condition: Design drawing non-conformance rate or RFI volume rising on recent information releases
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent notifies Design Manager for consultant performance intervention; Monitor Agent flags tasks relying on late information and quantifies potential claim exposure.

rules.trigger_condition: Cost forecast overrun beyond contingency consumption threshold
rules.recommended_action: Alert Agent escalates to Commercial Manager, Project Manager, and developer-client sponsor; Monitor Agent provides earned value decomposition identifying dominant cost growth drivers.
